review_scope: Ordinary terminal/protocol/auth/diagnostics/model metadata/task/page and declared-file stat association only. No NPZ/media open, hash or decode, no model reconstruction or geometric recomputation.

checks.independent_postreview: Verified ordinary metadata associations and exact declared field descriptors; did not repeat their array/geometric computations.

actual_preparation.node_window_scope: nearest original mechanism node on matching horizontal/vertical native node lines; not contact onset
actual_preparation.material_source_scope: Original arrays unchanged; fixed cell nodes imply interior F=I and Hu=0 without material evaluation

seal.scientific_NPZ_and_PNG: Original declared seal SHA plus current stat only, payloads not opened or rehashed.

pixel_QA_scope: Parent reports one actual new-PNG inspection: three panels readable; minor C-panel top statistics/dot overlap, first-line counts readable. Reviewer did not inspect pixels; no redraw.
qualification: Executed geometric/model/undeformed preparation compatibility only. No solved state, equilibrium, independent HP, fitted-circle boundary, contact, pressure, effective grip, unload/release, stability, energy or HF5 qualification. r9 staircase is the actual native boundary.
source_basis: 19-source map and original-binding unchanged declaration match frozen protocol; conservative static closure is not actual imported-module count. No universal dynamic mechanical/file-open hook is claimed.
